mapper.select: SELECT cg.group_type FROM question_bank qb INNER JOIN category_sub_module csm ON csm.id = qb.sub_module_id AND csm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_module cm ON cm.id = csm.module_id AND cm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_group cg ON cg.id = cm.group_id AND cg.is_deleted = 0 WHERE qb.id = #{bankId} AND qb.is_deleted = 0
